title: Personal responsibility
learning_outcomes: Explain responsibility versus blame in the context of personal responsibility.
Compare and distinguish authority and obligations in the context of personal responsibility.
Apply commitments in the context of personal responsibility.
Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of personal responsibility.

lessons.title: Responsibility versus blame
lessons.outcome: Explain responsibility versus blame in the context of personal responsibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving responsibility versus blame; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to accountability case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain responsibility versus blame from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of responsibility versus blame; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Authority and obligations
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish authority and obligations in the context of personal responsibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving authority and obligations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to accountability case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain authority and obligations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of authority and obligations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Commitments
lessons.outcome: Apply commitments in the context of personal responsibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving commitments; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to accountability case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain commitments from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of commitments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Repair
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of personal responsibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving repair; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to accountability case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain repair from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of responsibility versus blame; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of authority and obligations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of commitments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
